content: shadcn/ui Select wraps Radix Select; standard react-hook-form integration wraps it in Controller (or FormField, since shadcn's Select is not a native input and can't spread {...field} directly): <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} value={field.value}>. For a flat, short category list (this project's categories are a flat list, no search needed) Select is sufficient -- Combobox (Popover + Command, for searchable/large lists) is unnecessary complexity here and would need cmdk as an extra dependency.
